title: Friction-contact verification surface: repose / direct shear / packing density
principle: Thresholds, materials, protocols, numerical resolutions and the failure semantics are fixed here BEFORE any production run. Results are never used to re-tune a threshold. honest FAIL stays in the record.

contact_laws_under_test.tangential: F_t = min(mu*F_n, k_t*delta_t) + c_t*v_t   (declared form, cap_total=False)
contact_laws_under_test.tangential_default_in_kernel: F_t = proj_cone( min(mu*F_n, k_t*delta_t)*delta_hat + c_t*v_t ; mu*F_n )   (cap_total=True)
contact_laws_under_test.normal: F_n = max(k_n*overlap - c_n*v_n, 0), c_n = 2*zeta_n*sqrt(k_n*m_eff), zeta_n = |ln e|/sqrt(pi^2+ln^2 e)
contact_laws_under_test.rolling: M_r = min(mu_r*R_eff*F_n, k_r*|theta_r|) + c_r*|omega_rel|, opposed to relative spin

criteria.statement: Irrotational slider sliding-onset angle equals arctan(mu) (c_t = 0, cap_total=False)
Sphere rolling-onset angle on an incline equals arctan(mu_r)
mu = 0, mu_r = 0 frictionless pile has no stable slope: repose angle < 5 deg
Predicted repose angle vs experiment, two materials (glass beads, quartz sand)

glass_beads.source: literature experimental band for dry monodisperse soda-lime glass beads (d ~ 0.5-1.0 mm), see docs limitation note; not measured in this work

quartz_sand.source: literature experimental band for dry rounded-to-subrounded medium quartz sand; not measured in this work

criteria.protocol: micro-parameters taken from literature (mu_s of the material pair), NOT fitted to theta. mu_r is a single shape surrogate calibrated once on glass beads and transferred unchanged to sand (out-of-sample).

criteria.statement: Frictionless random close packing of monodisperse spheres reaches phi = 0.64 (Scott & Kilgour)
criteria.protocol: Lubachevsky-Stillinger soft-sphere inflation, two independent system sizes; cross-checked against the geometric quasi-static route of tensordem.bedcoupling.packing

criteria.statement: Direct-shear peak and residual strength predicted by the fitted Mohr-Coulomb envelope, worst relative deviation over all normal stresses
criteria.protocol: split shear box, 4 normal stress levels, peak = max over strain window, residual = mean of the last shear-strain window; envelope least-squares fit (c, phi) per branch

criteria.statement: Measured macroscopic friction angle respects the rigorous single-contact bound phi_macro <= arctan(mu + mu_r)
Cohesionless specimen: fitted cohesion magnitude is small relative to the smallest measured shear strength
criteria.note: reported, informational (a box with rough side walls can show apparent cohesion)

negative_results_policy: If a gated criterion fails, the artifact verdict stays FAIL and the failure is reported with the numbers. No threshold may be relaxed after seeing the data; a re-run with different physics must be registered as a new node.
limitations_declared_up_front: monodisperse spheres (no polydispersity, no angularity); rolling resistance stands in for shape effects
literature experimental theta values are quoted bands, not measurements performed here
direct shear box side walls are frictional and finite, so the stress field is non-uniform (standard box artefact)
stiffness is softened relative to real glass to keep the timestep affordable; stiffness affects dilatancy, not the friction bound
